noteOnTimestamps: This lane did not invent its timestamps. generatedAt is written live at file write time.
purpose: Deterministic contract for what may be translated/proposed/accepted versus what must stay immutable native source text, for controlled-English terminology alignment and downstream locale projection/back-translation readiness. This is a readiness contract and seed; it is not a completed translation.

boundSources.note: This lane reuses the corpus contract translation-boundary model and restates it for the language-terminology lane with citations only; it does not overwrite the corpus contract.

mustPreserveAsImmutableNative.rationale: Native terms can carry culturally or legally meaningful meaning that must not be normalized into an English gloss; English explanatory glosses are separate.
categories: traditional dish names where the native form is the culturally meaningful term
legal/authority names and official notice identifiers
source-native script forms where script is part of identity
source-original ingredient wording where wording is evidence
mustPreserveAsImmutableNative.rule: When a native term falls into one of these categories, the native alias/text must be preserved and any English gloss is a separate labeled interpretation, not a replacement.

localizableText.rationale: These are human-readable text fields whose controlled English rendering is the intended target of terminology/translation work, with source text preserved.
localizableText.rule: For each localizable field, the canonical record must retain original-language text plus source-language/locale/script metadata; English rendering is a separate layer with review status, concept IDs and per-field lineage where applicable.

glossaryContract.conceptIdRule: Each concept uses a stable concept/entity ID; aliases, narrower/broader/related/exact-match/candidate relations are versioned and evidence-backed.
glossaryContract.nativeAliasRule: Native terms are preserved as aliases/notes, not overwritten by English.
glossaryContract.interpretationLayerRule: English glosses are interpretations with review status; they are not new source facts.
glossaryContract.freezeStatus: No frozen corpus glossary is published by this lane; this lane may publish a candidate seed glossary with version + provenance, and the coordinator freezes later.
glossaryContract.versioning: Concept IDs may be stable while labels/aliases/definitions/relations are versioned; every change is provenance-logged.

recordShape.domain: ingredient | food | recipeInstruction | preparation | quantity | nutrient/dietary/certification | producer/supplier/retailer/businessIdentity | recall | price/unit
recordShape.aliasKind: exact | narrower | broader | related | exactMatchCandidate | candidate | untranslatable | regionalVariant

translationProposalModel.rule: Proposed English glosses never overwrite native text; accepted glosses remain interpretations and must keep lineage; unsupported proposals remain quarantined/unknown.

laneDeterministicChecksDerivedFromCorpus.identity: fixed identifiers and codes must not change across translation/projection
laneDeterministicChecksDerivedFromCorpus.units: quantity.unitId and unit dimension must be preserved; do not translate unit dimensions
laneDeterministicChecksDerivedFromCorpus.codes: countryCode/currencyCode/notice IDs/lot/GTIN identifiers must not be localized
laneDeterministicChecksDerivedFromCorpus.dates: dates/codes must be preserved as source values; formatting changes are separate from value changes
laneDeterministicChecksDerivedFromCorpus.negation: negation and qualifiers in localizable text must not be dropped or flipped during translation
laneDeterministicChecksDerivedFromCorpus.allergenAndDietary: allergen/dietary claims must not be inferred from translation; they require evidence
laneDeterministicChecksDerivedFromCorpus.recall: recall jurisdiction/markets/lot/GTIN and notice IDs must not be altered by translation
laneDeterministicChecksDerivedFromCorpus.citations: source citations/archive hashes must be preserved verbatim

uncertainties: This lane does not yet have a frozen glossary; concept IDs proposed here are candidate seeds.
Translation/projection coverage per locale is not asserted; the union target inventory is a target, not a completion report.
Independent review of difficult translations is required before any sensitive assertion can be accepted; two models agreeing or model self-confidence is not sufficient.

translationBoundaryRules.assertion: source-native dish names such as 'museau de boeuf' are preserved as immutable native aliases; English glosses are separate interpretations with review status
dietary/allergen claims are not inferred from a source name alone; inserted dietary paraphrase must not replace composition-preserving rendering
source-native recall notice identifiers, jurisdiction/markets, lot/GTIN and dates remain source values; English rendering is a separate interpretative layer only
observed price is preserved as observed; conversion is separate dated evidence; observed vs converted must stay distinct
